# Chasin' Coverage

> Independent health insurance agency owned by Chase Tabor, a licensed agent (National Producer Number 22123071) based in the Houston, Texas area. Chasin' Coverage helps individuals, families, and small businesses find Medical, Life, Dental, and Vision coverage. Consults are free, 15 minutes, and no-pressure: Chase compares real plan options for the client's state, explains tradeoffs in plain English, and handles enrollment. Clients never pay a guidance fee — Chase is compensated by carriers only when someone enrolls.

## Services
- Medical / health plans: individual, family, and small-business (including 2-3 person micro-groups and owner-only setups)
- Life insurance: protection sized to household and budget
- Dental insurance: preventive and full dental
- Vision insurance: exams, lenses, and frames that pair with the medical plan
- Life-change help: job change, marriage, move, or loss of coverage — special enrollment windows handled correctly
- Plan reviews: cost and fit check before auto-renewal, including marketplace plan switches

## Service area
Licensed in 30+ states: most US states except CA, CT, WA, OR, NM, NY, NJ, NH, MA, ME, MN, ND, ID, HI, RI, AK. Based in the Houston area (Texas); works with clients by phone and video, with particular focus on Texas and Louisiana.

## Why clients choose Chase
- Owner-operated: clients talk to Chase directly, never a call center
- Plain-English comparisons: networks and deductibles without the fog
- No pressure to buy on the first call; no obligation
- 5.0-star client reviews on Facebook, including reviews from Houston, Austin, Oklahoma City, and Columbia SC clients
